name: Linux Systems Fundamentals
description: Core Linux operating system commands, shell navigation, permissions, file system hierarchy, process management, and basic bash scripting.

name: Docker & Containerization
description: Container virtualization, Dockerfile writing, multi-stage builds, container networking, volume mounting, and docker-compose multi-service setups.

name: Kubernetes Cluster Orchestration
description: Production container orchestration using Kubernetes: Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Ingress, Helm packaging, and automated rollouts.

name: Service Mesh & Cloud Traffic Engineering
description: Advanced enterprise service mesh (Istio/Linkerd), mutual TLS (mTLS), distributed tracing, canary traffic routing, and ingress gateways.

name: Python Core Programming
description: Python syntax, object-oriented programming, data structures, error handling, virtual environments, and standard library modules.

name: REST API Architecture & Web Services
description: Building high-performance asynchronous RESTful APIs using FastAPI or Django REST, HTTP status codes, routing, serialization, and OpenAPI documentation.

name: Microservices & Distributed Architecture
description: Decomposing monolithic backends into scalable microservices, asynchronous messaging with Kafka/RabbitMQ, database per service, and API gateways.

name: Data Analysis with NumPy & Pandas
description: Vectorized computations with NumPy, tabular data manipulation, filtering, aggregation, and data cleaning using Python Pandas.

name: Machine Learning Fundamentals
description: Supervised and unsupervised ML algorithms with Scikit-Learn: linear/logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, clustering, and cross-validation.

name: Deep Learning & Neural Networks with PyTorch
description: Constructing and training neural networks in PyTorch, backpropagation, CNNs for computer vision, RNNs/Transformers for NLP, and GPU acceleration.

name: MLOps & Production Model Deployment
description: Production ML model lifecycle: MLflow model tracking, automated retraining pipelines, Triton/FastAPI model serving, monitoring, and drift detection.

name: Computer Networking & Protocols
description: TCP/IP model, DNS resolution, subnetting, CIDR, firewalls, TLS/SSL certificates, HTTP/HTTPS protocols, and network troubleshooting tools.

name: Cloud Architecture & AWS Services
description: Designing multi-tier cloud applications on AWS: VPC networking, EC2 compute, S3 storage, RDS databases, IAM security roles, and CloudWatch.

name: Terraform & Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
description: Declarative multi-cloud provisioning with Terraform: HCL modules, state management, remote backends, drift detection, and automated CI/CD plans.

name: Financial Accounting & GAAP Principles
description: Double-entry bookkeeping, general ledger, income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, accrual accounting, and US GAAP rules.

name: Financial Statement & Ratio Analysis
description: Evaluating corporate liquidity, solvency, profitability, Dupont analysis, working capital cycles, and footnote auditing in SEC 10-K filings.

name: Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) & Valuation
description: Unlevered free cash flow forecasting, Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), terminal value calculation, and sensitivity scenario analysis.

name: Leveraged Buyout (LBO) & Advanced Financial Modeling
description: Building dynamic 3-statement financial models, debt schedules, mezzanine financing, return waterfalls (IRR/MoIC), and covenant stress-testing.

name: Quantitative Risk & Portfolio Analysis
description: Value at Risk (VaR), Monte Carlo simulation, modern portfolio theory, Sharpe ratio optimization, and credit default modeling in Python.

name: Medical Terminology & Anatomy Basics
description: Clinical prefixes, suffixes, root words, anatomical planes, body systems, common pathologies, diagnostic tests, and pharmacological classes.

name: Hospital Clinical Workflows & Patient Care
description: Emergency triage, patient admission, bedside nursing interventions, physician order execution, medication administration, and clinical discharge.

name: Electronic Health Record (EHR) Systems
description: Clinical documentation in hospital EHR systems (Epic/Cerner), clinical decision support, medication reconciliation, and order sets.

name: HIPAA Compliance & Health Data Privacy
description: HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules, Protected Health Information (PHI) safeguards, Business Associate Agreements (BAAs), and breach reporting.

name: HL7 & FHIR Health Data Interoperability
description: Exchanging clinical data using HL7 v2 messaging and HL7 FHIR RESTful resources, SMART-on-FHIR app integration, and EHR integration engines.

name: Legal Research & Statutory Analysis
description: Primary and secondary legal authorities, statutory interpretation, Shepardizing case law citations, and research in Westlaw/LexisNexis.

name: Commercial Contract Drafting & Review
description: Drafting Master Services Agreements (MSAs), representations and warranties, indemnification clauses, limitation of liability, and breach remedies.

name: Corporate Regulatory Compliance & Auditing
description: Corporate governance programs, SEC/FINRA compliance frameworks, internal risk audits, whistleblower protocols, and regulatory defense.

name: Global Data Privacy & GDPR/CCPA Law
description: International data transfer mechanisms, Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), GDPR/CCPA consumer rights, and privacy by design.

name: Electrical Safety & AC/DC Fundamentals
description: Ohm's Law, series and parallel circuits, multimeter diagnostics, NFPA 70E electrical safety, lockout/tagout (LOTO), and grounding principles.

name: Electrical Schematic & Blueprint Reading
description: Reading industrial wiring diagrams, single-line schematics, relay logic symbols, motor control centers, and panel layout blueprints.

name: Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC) & Ladder Logic
description: Programming industrial PLCs (Allen-Bradley / Siemens), ladder logic rungs, timers, counters, digital/analog I/O wiring, and motor starters.

name: SCADA & Industrial Control Telemetry
description: Industrial Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA), Human-Machine Interface (HMI) screens, Modbus/Profibus industrial protocols.

name: HVAC Refrigeration & Thermodynamic Principles
description: Vapor-compression refrigeration cycle, pressure-enthalpy charts, superheat/subcooling calculations, compressor diagnostics, and EPA 608.

name: Building Automation & BACnet Controls
description: Building Management Systems (BMS), BACnet MS/TP and IP protocols, Direct Digital Controls (DDC), variable air volume (VAV) controllers.
